verdict.rationale: Proactive alerting is a fair question for an FP&A platform, but the evidence shows no capability that notifies a finance lead when a metric moves against plan or a reporting deadline approaches. Scan variance analysis is user-initiated: the user picks a threshold and runs it. The 24/7 monitoring with Slack/Teams alerts applies only to data-mapping suggestions, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here. Real-time dashboards show metrics but are not documented to push alerts.
